input.title: Разработчик на софтуер PLC

requirements.text: Degree in automation, mechatronics, electrical engineering/IT, technical computer science or similar
IEC 61131-3 structured text, ideally Beckhoff TwinCAT3 and Codesys
Other languages such as C++, Python or Java

notes: The language bullet mixes a must (English) and a plus (German), so it is two requirements.
